description: Model My Watershed is Stroud Water Research Center's web application for comparing land-use and conservation scenarios through runoff and water-quality models. It contains GIS preparation tools and a site-storm model, plus the GWLF-E multi-year watershed model. Users select an area and supply scenario changes; outputs include water fluxes, nutrient and sediment estimates. The documented United States application includes a 24-hour storm calculation and thirty years of daily water-balance simulation, with monthly watershed summaries. Apache-2.0 application source is free; hosted API use requires a user key. A limitation is that calibrated API operations are restricted to the Delaware River Basin, and documentation identifies incomplete or old point-source data elsewhere. The platform supports stormwater, wastewater-impact and watershed intervention simulations. EPA SWMM (model-epa-swmm) provides related drainage modelling. Public documentation was reviewed without creating an account or running an API job.
